metadata.title: Data Loss Prevention

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for detecting and preventing unauthorized disclosure, exfiltration, or misuse of institutional data.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Data loss prevention controls including content inspection, egress monitoring, and policy-enforced restrictions.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for enforcing data handling and disclosure constraints at data egress points.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Data loss prevention enforces permitted and prohibited data behaviors defined at the policy level.

metadata.remarks: Data Loss Prevention defines trust properties required to prevent data from leaving institutional control in violation of policy. DLP enforces data-centric rules at egress points and does not make application authorization or data classification decisions.

components.title: Egress Monitoring and Control
components.description: Monitors and controls outbound data flows across institutional boundaries.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exfiltration of data through unauthorized outbound channels.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Outbound traffic monitoring and restriction to prevent data exfiltration.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Outbound data flows are monitored for unauthorized disclosure.

components.title: Content Inspection and Classification
components.description: Detects sensitive data based on content, patterns, or classification signals.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exposure of sensitive data through uninspected or misidentified content.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Content inspection and sensitive data detection.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanisms inspect content to identify sensitive data before transmission.

components.title: Policy-Enforced Restrictions
components.description: Blocks, conditionally allows, or constrains data flows based on policy.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Circumvention of data handling policy during transmission.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy-driven enforcement of data disclosure restrictions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies define and enforce restrictions on data disclosure.

components.title: Incident Signaling and Escalation
components.description: Generates alerts and initiates response when data loss risk is detected.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression of alerts related to data loss events.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Alerting and escalation for rapid incident response.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Alerts support detection and response to data loss incidents.
